from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyBalanceSheet(BaseModel):
    """Financial statement data from one company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the filing")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The period end date, e.g., 'March 31, 2024'")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total Assets from the balance sheet")
    total_current_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total Current Assets from the balance sheet")
    total_non_current_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total Non-current Assets if explicitly reported; None if needs derivation")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How amounts are scaled: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_balance_sheets: list[CompanyBalanceSheet]
